notes: Unified every canonical non-cyberware item description card onto one FEHA visual system: firearms, melee, unique weapons, armor, grenades, consumables, and Quickhacks.

All unified cards now share the same dark #071116 shell, cyan FEHA header, white item title, three-column stat grid, muted stat labels, gold market/special accents, and consistent cyan effect/passive panels.
Firearm manufacturer passives and bespoke weapon systems were preserved while moving to the unified card.
Melee and unique weapons now use the same shell and stat hierarchy as firearms instead of separate red/gold layouts.
Armor cards now show the armor name, type, AC, Dexterity contribution, weight, market price, availability, and passive using the common layout.
Grenade cards now expose delivery, damage, range, radius, market price, activation, and full effect in the common layout.
Consumables now use the common layout while retaining Short Rest use-limit language and one-time permanent treatment handling.
Quickhack cards now use the common layout with title, tier identity, RAM, quality, availability, market price, activation, and effect.
Cyberware sheets were intentionally excluded and remain untouched for the upcoming cyberware pass.
